high_court_outcome.quote: reversed the acquittal of A-1, A-2 and A-3 and convicted these accused for the offence punishable under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court reversed the acquittal and convicted; 'Not applicable' contradicts this.

final_outcome.quote: The accused appellants are acquitted of all the charges.
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court acquitted the appellants of all charges.

offence_finally_established.quote: The accused appellants are acquitted of all the charges.
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established given the acquittal.

imprisonment_years.quote: is hereby reversed. The accused appellants are acquitted
imprisonment_years.reason: No final imprisonment term, consistent with acquittal.

fine_rs.quote: The impugned judgment ... is hereby reversed.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Prosecution alleged complainant was an eyewitness; the court later found this claim contradicted

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment and Rs. 50,000 fine each (High Court sentence, later set aside)

attempt_completion.quote: belaboured Malagounda, as a result of which he fell down

number_of_offences.quote: convicted these accused for the offence punishable under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC
